preConditions.onFailMessage: LEGACY_MODELING_PLAN_SQL_MODEL_RETIREMENT_BLOCKED: migrate or archive legacy rows and catalog identities, then remove unknown dependencies

and.sqlCheck: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_plan) + (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_sql_model)

SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.contype = 'f' AND ( ( c.conrelid = 'modeling_plan'::regclass AND c.confrelid = 'catalog_domain'::regclass AND c.conname = 'fk_modeling_plan_domain' ) OR ( c.conrelid = 'modeling_sql_model'::regclass AND c.confrelid = 'modeling_model_spec'::regclass AND c.conname = 'fk_modeling_sql_model_spec' ) )

SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.contype = 'f' AND ( c.conrelid IN ('modeling_plan'::regclass, 'modeling_sql_model'::regclass) OR c.confrelid IN ('modeling_plan'::regclass, 'modeling_sql_model'::regclass) ) AND NOT ( ( c.conrelid = 'modeling_plan'::regclass AND c.confrelid = 'catalog_domain'::regclass AND c.conname = 'fk_modeling_plan_domain' ) OR ( c.conrelid = 'modeling_sql_model'::regclass AND c.confrelid = 'modeling_model_spec'::regclass AND c.conname = 'fk_modeling_sql_model_spec' ) )

SELECT count(DISTINCT dependent_view.oid) FROM pg_depend dependency JOIN pg_rewrite rewrite_rule ON rewrite_rule.oid = dependency.objid JOIN pg_class dependent_view ON dependent_view.oid = rewrite_rule.ev_class WHERE dependency.refobjid IN ('modeling_plan'::regclass, 'modeling_sql_model'::regclass) AND dependent_view.relkind IN ('v', 'm')

SELECT sum(reference_count) FROM ( SELECT count(*) AS reference_count FROM asset_grant WHERE upper(asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN') UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM asset_ownership WHERE upper(asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN') UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM asset_permission_audit WHERE upper(asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN') UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM asset_permission_policy_injection WHERE upper(asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN') UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_asset_tag WHERE upper(asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN') UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_classification_event WHERE upper(asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN') UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_classification_migration_item WHERE upper(asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN') UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_classification_snapshot WHERE upper(asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN') UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_dataset_lineage WHERE upper(upstream_asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN') UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_dataset_lineage WHERE upper(downstream_asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN') UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_external_asset_identity WHERE upper(asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN') UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_external_asset_sync_item WHERE upper(asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN') ) legacy_catalog_reference

changeSet.comment: Remove the empty pre-ModelSpec SQL-model and plan stores after all callers have converged on WarehousePlan, ModelSpec revisions, release candidates and materialization. Persisted legacy catalog identities or unknown relational dependencies halt deployment; no cascade is permitted.
changeSet.sql: LOCK TABLE modeling_plan, modeling_sql_model IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE

LOCK TABLE asset_grant, asset_ownership, asset_permission_audit, asset_permission_policy_injection, catalog_asset_tag, catalog_classification_event, catalog_classification_migration_item, catalog_classification_snapshot, catalog_dataset_lineage, catalog_external_asset_identity, catalog_external_asset_sync_item IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE

DO $$ BEGIN IF ( (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_plan) + (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_sql_model) + (SELECT count(*) FROM asset_grant WHERE upper(asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN')) + (SELECT count(*) FROM asset_ownership WHERE upper(asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN')) + (SELECT count(*) FROM asset_permission_audit WHERE upper(asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN')) + (SELECT count(*) FROM asset_permission_policy_injection WHERE upper(asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN')) + (SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_asset_tag WHERE upper(asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN')) + (SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_classification_event WHERE upper(asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN')) + (SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_classification_migration_item WHERE upper(asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN')) + (SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_classification_snapshot WHERE upper(asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN')) + (SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_dataset_lineage WHERE upper(upstream_asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN')) + (SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_dataset_lineage WHERE upper(downstream_asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN')) + (SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_external_asset_identity WHERE upper(asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN')) + (SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_external_asset_sync_item WHERE upper(asset_type) IN ('MODELING_SQL_MODEL', 'MODELING_PLAN')) ) <> 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LEGACY_MODELING_PLAN_SQL_MODEL_RETIREMENT_LOCKED_RECHECK_FAILED'; END IF; END $$;
